entries.title: One series palette for the whole site, and INDY NXT gets a colour

values.label: the road (default): cool blues and greens for the junior years, warming to INDY NXT gold for the current chapter; every neighbouring pair passes the colour-blind check
atlas: six evenly spread hues (blue, green, wine, teal, rust, violet), INDY NXT gold; livelier, less of a story
before: the palette live now, INDY NXT in black

entries.look: Career → His life in weeks, the chapters (INDY NXT's dots), the odometer, the travel map; then About and Data. Flip the three and watch the same series keep one colour everywhere. On Life in weeks, point at (or tap) a series in the key to light only its weeks.

entries.title: The odometer: colour and a read on every tile
entries.noswitch: new reads on tiles that had none; nothing to switch back to
entries.look: Career → the odometer. Point at (or tap) each: a series segment on On track; a bar on Distance (it thickens and reads its miles); a part of Time (timed, untimed, other sessions); any of the 619 dots on Other drivers (name, the series he first raced them in, races together); a country or a track dot on Places (the track still and every track there); a cell on When it went wrong (the race, its still, and on a second tap the race page).
